title.zh: 修订第2701号共和国法（即《为公共工程拨款并与以往公共工程拨款同步的法案》）中某一项目的法案
title.en: An Act Amending Certain Item of Republic Act Numbered Two Thousand Seven Hundred and One, Entitled “An Act to Appropriate Funds for Public Works, Synchronizing the Same with Previous Public Works Appropriations”
title.orig: An Act Amending Certain Item of Republic Act Numbered Two Thousand Seven Hundred and One, Entitled “An Act to Appropriate Funds for Public Works, Synchronizing the Same with Previous Public Works Appropriations”

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1961/ra_3309_1961.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Item (a), under Group II (re projects for the Province of Negros Oriental), page 534, Section two, entitled "Short-term Projects," of Republic Act Numbered Two thousand seven hundred and one, is hereby amended to read as follows:
"(a) Santa Catalina Municipal Building ₱4,000.00 "(a-1) Lazi Municipal Building Construction 17,000.00"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1961.
